label: Trace exporter
description: Sending this tree's runs to an OpenTelemetry collector. A project's startup list names `export` to open it: nothing phones home on its own, so a tree that does not ask to export does not. It names no trigger -- every run of every trigger is exported, because every run already leaves a report.

export.description: Subscribe to every run this tree serves and send it to the collector as spans, until the process stops. Export is batched and asynchronous, so a slow collector never delays an answer, and a collector that cannot be reached is said out loud and never fails the run whose trace it was handed. Answers where it sends and under what name, so a startup report says so.

level.description: how much a span carries: "summary" or "full"; absent: the @otel plugin's settings.level, and "summary" when that is absent too

service.description: the service.name every exported span carries
